items: Tender spot on top of foot

slides.title:

Book via the link in bio

caption:
Toto switched to thin minimalist shoes and ran 10 km on day one. By the next day, his calves and feet were complaining.

Thinner shoes ask more of your calves, Achilles and feet. The shoes change in a day, but your body usually needs a lot longer to adapt.

Hybi's plan: wear them for walking first, swap in a short part of an easy run, do calf raises (10 reps × 2 sets) daily, and add a little more only if you feel fine the next day.

A tender spot on top of the foot, a stiff heel every morning, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
